note: Strategy profiles for the deck library, one per deck. `basis` says where a section comes from: source = stated in the deck's source write-up; cards = our reading of the official card text; both = the source plus our reading. A section with a null text has no evidence yet, and nothing is invented for it. `ai` is the part the AI uses: card IDs from the deck, most preferred first.

winCondition.text: Fill the rear-guard circles so King of Knights, Alfred gains +2000 per Royal Paladin rear-guard without a boost, with Soul Saver Dragon's five soul giving three rear-guards +5000 as the alternative finish.

ride.text: Alfred first, with Soul Saver support; Pongal searches Soul Saver Dragon. Barcgal is the first vanguard.

mulligan.text: Keep one of each grade with Alfred as the target; Pongal counts as a route to the alternative grade 3.

field.text: Marron, and Lake Maiden Lien as a filter, boost the side columns; the vanguard needs no booster because Alfred cannot be boosted, so every circle is worth filling.

resources.text: Counter-Blast 3 on Alfred fetches a grade 2 or less; save soul towards five if Soul Saver is the plan.

combat.text: Alfred's power grows with the field, so build the field before attacking. Attack with the vanguard first while rear-guards can use its triggers.

defence.text: Gordon's intercept (+5000 shield) is the main defensive tool alongside Iseult.

recovery.text: Without Alfred, ride Soul Saver or Bors; Alfred's Counter-Blast rebuilds a removed field one unit at a time.

winCondition.text: The Blond Ezel ride chain reaches grade 3 ahead of the opponent; Viviane and Ezel's superior calls fill the field quickly for Ezel's continuous power, forcing repeated guards from 20000-and-above lines.

ride.text: Kyrph, Gareth, Beaumains: with Kyrph and Gareth on (RC) and Beaumains on (VC), Kyrph's [ACT] searches and rides Blond Ezel early.

mulligan.text: Gareth and Beaumains are the priority, since they enable the early Ezel; Ezel himself can be searched from the deck.

field.text: Minimal direct calling and low cost: superior calls do the work, Sleygals combine for power, and Manawydan attacks with a Gold Paladin boost.

resources.text: Tripp unflips damage so the Sleygals and Viviane can Counter-Blast repeatedly.

combat.text: Boost Viviane and Tripp so their on-hit abilities trigger; press with every line above 20000.

defence.text: Mark as a perfect guard, paid with a Gold Paladin from hand.

recovery.text: If the chain is missed, ride Manawydan or a natural Ezel; Viviane's call still refills open circles on a hit.

winCondition.text: Dudley Emperor's Limit Break brings out two more Spike Brothers once the field has opened, chiefly Juggernaut Maximum and Brakki, which attack at 16000 before a boost and return to the deck. Zachary deals free damage at grade 2.

ride.text: Medical Manager and Wonder Boy are the preferred grade 1 rides for the first and second turns; Black Panther is the grade 2 vanguard; Dudley Emperor is the finish.

mulligan.text: Mecha Trainer can fetch any grade 1, Marilyn or Express by situation, so a missing grade 1 is less urgent than grade 2 and Dudley.

field.text: Wonder Boy assists the returning attackers up to 24000. Units are meant to leave and be replaced.

resources.text: The Limit Break costs two Spike Brothers from hand, which weakens the hand; Medical Manager's Soul-Charge pays for the self-returning attackers' Soul-Blast.

combat.text: Vacate circles with the returning attackers so Dudley has open circles to call into, and let Zachary hit and run before Limit Break.

defence.text: The hand is thin after Limit Break; Zachary's pressure draws cards from the opponent's hand if they guard.

recovery.text: Before four damage, keep attacking with self-returning units and Zachary rather than holding them.

winCondition.text: Hold LuLu's ability for the endgame. Riding CoCo or Sakuya pops her out of the soul to draw; CoCo then has an empty soul for +3000 and a two-card draw, while Sakuya returns the field to hand for +4000 with four or more cards.

ride.text: LuLu first vanguard; CoCo or Sakuya at grade 3 by situation.

mulligan.text: Grade 1 and 2 rides that keep the soul small come first; either grade 3 works.

field.text: Sakuya's return lets the field be rearranged freely and LuLu saved as a 10000 shield; Mocha and Sakuya want four or more cards in hand.

resources.text: Psychic Bird and Luck Bird manage the soul and hand; keep the soul at one or fewer before riding CoCo.

combat.text: Silent Tom attacks stop grade 0 guards; a large hand powers both Mocha and the vanguard.

defence.text: Hand size is the defence: returning units adds shield on demand.

recovery.text: If the soul has grown too big for CoCo, ride Sakuya instead.

winCondition.text: A faster game than the break rides of its format: Descendant and Gauntlet Buster, with no bad grade 3 ride. Both have skills outside Limit Break, so baiting them by leaving them at three damage does not work.

ride.text: Either grade 3; their 11000 bases also make them useful rear-guards. Spark Kid Dragoon can search a grade 3.

mulligan.text: Any grade 3 is fine, so prioritise grades 1 and 2 with the attack-boost skills.

field.text: Deathscythe supports Gauntlet Buster and controls the field; Demolition Dragon and Spark Rain attack at +3000 with an Eradicator vanguard.

resources.text: Gauntlet Buster and Descendant share Counter-Blast 2 from Eradicator cards; Descendant's restand also needs three Eradicators from hand.

combat.text: Retire a rear-guard before attacking at Limit Break so Gauntlet Buster gets +3000 and +1 critical.

defence.text: Guld as perfect guard; save hand for Descendant's cost when that line is on.

recovery.text: Retiring and forcing retires works from early on, so continue the plan under four damage.

matchups.text: Luquier Reverse was called a hard counter to Descendant builds, since soul-based calls avoid Deathscythe's retires.

winCondition.text: Retire rear-guards with Cho-Ou and Deathscythe so Gauntlet Buster's Limit Break gains +3000 and +1 critical for each, reported as the top Open-division deck at Kanazawa.

ride.text: Vowing Sword as a break ride under Gauntlet Buster when available; otherwise Gauntlet Buster or Descendant directly.

mulligan.text: Grade 2 Cho-Ou and grade 1 attackers first; keep one grade 3.

field.text: Cho-Ou moves an Eradicator to the soul to retire a front-row unit, fuelling Rising Phoenix's draw.

resources.text: Soul from Cho-Ou pays for Rising Phoenix; Counter-Blast 2 is for Gauntlet Buster's forced retire.

combat.text: Do retire effects in the main phase before attacks; Shuki also gains +3000 on each.

defence.text: Guld as perfect guard; Castor draws when the opponent has two or fewer rear-guards.

recovery.text: Against an empty opposing field, retire effects have no target, so the plan becomes plain pressure and Castor's draw.

matchups.text: Liberators were named its constant rival in this format.

winCondition.text: Break ride Solitary Liberator Gancelot with Liberator of the Round Table, Alfred: +10000 on the vanguard, +5000 on three rear-guards, and Alfred's +2000 per Liberator rear-guard at Limit Break.

ride.text: Gancelot first, Round Table Alfred over it at four damage.

mulligan.text: Gancelot and a grade 1 and 2 to ride; Alfred can be held for later.

field.text: Fill the field before the break ride so all three +5000s land; Marron and Phallon attack at +3000.

resources.text: Alfred's Counter-Blast 2 from Liberators looks at the top card to call; Josephus draws when called from the deck.

combat.text: Attack with the pumped rear-guards alongside the vanguard to demand several guards in one turn.

defence.text: Mark Liberator as perfect guard.

recovery.text: Without the break ride, Alfred alone still gains from a full Liberator field.

matchups.text: Named the Eradicators' constant rival in the 2013 Open divisions.

winCondition.text: Soul-based calls: Ionela and Irina call two units at once, one to the field and one to the soul, then Luquier Reverse's Limit Break chain-locks rear-guards to call from the soul, multiplying one card into several.

ride.text: Luquier the Dragon Tamer under Reverse, which gains +2000 with her in the soul; Eva is the other break ride.

mulligan.text: Irina and a grade 2 first, then any grade 3 of the three.

field.text: Keep cards in the soul: the opponent cannot retire it, so field removal matters less.

resources.text: Nitro Juggler soul-charges; each Reverse activation needs Counter-Blast 1 and a rear-guard to lock.

combat.text: Lock used-up rear-guards to refresh circles with fresh attackers before the battle phase.

defence.text: Lydia as perfect guard.

recovery.text: With little soul, Irina and Trapezist rebuild it before Limit Break matters.

matchups.text: Called a hard counter to Descendant, because its retires do not reach the soul.

winCondition.text: Enigman Storm's grade security with Daikaiser's break ride, and Laurel to stand a 26000-plus critical 3 vanguard. Fifteen grade 3s drive-check often enough to retire perfect guards.

ride.text: Flow, Ripple, Wave, Storm is the chain, with Daikaiser under Storm or Daiyusha at four damage.

mulligan.text: Ripple and Wave are the priority: Flow searches Wave when Ripple rides it, and high grade counts make grade 3 easy.

field.text: Commander Laurel needs four Dimension Police rear-guards to rest, so a full field is part of the combo.

resources.text: Daikaiser's ride costs Counter-Blast 1; Mika's draw costs Counter-Blast 2, so spend on her only when the combo is safe.

combat.text: Vanguard power crosses the attack-step thresholds for +1 critical; rest four with Laurel on a hit to stand it.

defence.text: Diamond Ace as perfect guard; Ripple's and the chain's discards can take grade 3s.

recovery.text: Lady Justice and Daiyusha work without the chain.

matchups.text: Its drive-checked grade 3s retire opposing guardians, including perfect guards.

winCondition.text: Control: lock opposing rear-guards so they cannot be used or called over, then retire them later as they unlock. Chaos Breaker was described as a dominant control deck of its format.

ride.text: Infinite Zero under Chaos Breaker: the break ride locks two rear-guards and gives +10000. Mobius Breath on the vanguard circle locks on a hit.

mulligan.text: Infinite Zero and a grade 2 first; Pleiades can search a grade 3 from the deck.

field.text: Chaos Beat boosts Chaos Breaker at +5000 once anything is locked; Colony Maker calls a grade 1 or less while the opponent has a lock.

resources.text: Soul-Blast 1 of Star-vaders for each retire and draw; Counter-Blast 1 plus a discard for each extra lock.

combat.text: Lock first, then attack: locked rear-guards cannot intercept or boost.

defence.text: Promethium as perfect guard.

recovery.text: If the opponent has no rear-guards to lock, Radon and Neon still attack at +3000.

winCondition.text: The same lock and retire control as Chaos Breaker, built around the Infinite Zero break ride, here with Lanthanum gaining power from each lock.

ride.text: Infinite Zero then Chaos Breaker; Mobius Breath at grade 2.

mulligan.text: Infinite Zero, then a grade 2; Pleiades or Dust Tail helps by situation.

field.text: Lanthanum gains +2000 per lock; Colony Maker fills the field while a lock is up; Aurora Eagle boosts the vanguard with more rear-guards.

resources.text: As Chaos Breaker: Soul-Blast of Star-vaders and Counter-Blast 1 per extra lock.

combat.text: Lock before attacking so Lanthanum's bonus is live.

defence.text: Promethium as perfect guard.

recovery.text: Palladium re-locks an unlocking unit if the break ride is delayed.

winCondition.text: The source's game-deciding play: break ride Dragonic Overlord the End over Dauntless Drive, then use the End's persona ability to stand for a second attack and more drive checks.

ride.text: Dauntless Drive at grade 3, the End over it at four damage.

mulligan.text: Dauntless Drive and a second grade 3; a spare End is the persona cost, so grade 3s are worth keeping.

field.text: Bahr and Nehalem form plain high-power lines; Burning Horn gains +3000 with an Overlord vanguard; Kersey draws against a grade 2.

resources.text: Keep Counter-Blast 2 and a spare End for the persona ability.

combat.text: The vanguard is the threat: the base 21000 to 23000 line wins on its own once it stands.

defence.text: The End's higher defence lets 16000 lines be blocked with one 5000 shield.

recovery.text: Without the break ride, the End alone still has its persona ability.

winCondition.text: Dauntless Drive's break ride gives +10000 and a three-card discard to stand, with Nouvelle Vague or Dauntless Dominate over it as the finish.

ride.text: Dauntless Drive, then Dominate Reverse or Nouvelle Vague over it.

mulligan.text: Dauntless Drive first; a second grade 3 or grade 4 for the break ride.

field.text: Dominate Drive attacks at +3000; Bellicosity unflips damage; Gojo filters excess cards.

resources.text: Keep three cards for the restand; Nouvelle Vague's retire needs Counter-Blast 3, Soul-Blast 3 and a spare copy.

combat.text: Attack with the vanguard first or last by whether you intend to stand it.

defence.text: Barri and Maria as perfect guards.

recovery.text: Calamity Tower Wyvern's soul draw rebuilds a hand spent on a restand.

winCondition.text: Break ride Overlord The Re-birth over Dragonic Overlord, lock five rear-guards for +10000 and a stand, with on-call units that reuse the circles it locks.

ride.text: Dragonic Overlord under Re-birth; Eternal Bringer Griffin was prioritised to find it.

mulligan.text: Griffin and grade 3s first: reaching the break ride is the priority.

field.text: Dragonic Burnout and Berserk Dragon are favoured for field control when called, using circles freed by locks.

resources.text: Keep two Kagero for the discard to stand; Berserk's retire costs Counter-Blast 2.

combat.text: Attack with rear-guards before locking them, then swing with the vanguard at +10000.

defence.text: Rinocross as perfect guard.

recovery.text: Dragonic Overlord's own Counter-Blast 3 restand is the fallback.

winCondition.text: Break ride Nouvelle Vague over Dauntless Drive. On your turn all opposing trigger effects are nullified and grade 0s cannot guard; its Limit Break retires every opposing rear-guard.

ride.text: Dauntless Drive at grade 3, then Nouvelle Vague at grade 4. Sources describe it as a break-ride-centric deck.

mulligan.text: Dauntless Drive and Nouvelle Vague; Nouvelleroman can search a grade 3 or greater.

field.text: Nouvellecritic and Berserk retire rear-guards when called; Dominate Drive attacks at +3000.

resources.text: Save Counter-Blast 3, Soul-Blast 3 and a spare Nouvelle Vague for the field wipe; Artpique and Calamity Tower Wyvern handle soul.

combat.text: Wipe the field in the main phase, then attack: no intercepts, and fewer guards.

defence.text: Maria as perfect guard.

recovery.text: Dragonic Overlord and Dauntless Drive carry the deck if Nouvelle Vague is missed.

matchups.text: Reported in direct competition with Shotgun Blow's Brawlers in spring 2014.

winCondition.text: Twin bosses Mordred Phantom and Raging Form: Mordred's break ride gives +10000 and a search; Raging Form retires three Revenger rear-guards to ride another copy standing at +10000.

ride.text: Mordred Phantom under Raging Form. Two Claudas fetch two Blaster Dark Revengers without relying on Mordred's break ride.

mulligan.text: Mordred and Raging Form, then Dorint and Blaster Dark Revenger.

field.text: Rear-guards feed the three-unit retire; Masquerades attack at +3000 and Dorint unflips when Blaster Dark Revenger arrives in its column.

resources.text: Dorint supports repeated Counter-Blasts; hold a second Raging Form for the standing ride.

combat.text: Attack with rear-guards first, then swing with Raging Form and retire them for the second strike.

defence.text: Mac Lir as perfect guard.

recovery.text: Tartu calls a grade 1 or less to refill a column for the retire.

winCondition.text: Raging Form with the Legion grade 3 Phantom Blaster Abyss: two separate self-standing vanguards, each attacking around 21000 to 22000 on the second strike.

ride.text: Either grade 3, with Abyss legioning Blaster Dark Revenger Abyss when the drop zone has four cards.

mulligan.text: Both grade 3s; the Legion mate can be searched.

field.text: Three Revengers to retire for the stand; Tartu and Masquerade fill columns.

resources.text: Counter-Blast heavy, offset by its unflipping engine; Dorint and Blaster Dark Revenger.

combat.text: Second strikes are the plan: spend rear-guards as the cost after they have attacked.

defence.text: Mac Lir as perfect guard.

recovery.text: If Legion is off for lack of a grade 3 opponent, Raging Form's own stand still works.

winCondition.text: Omega Lock: Glendios's Limit Break keeps the opponent's locked cards from unlocking at their next end phase, and at Limit Break 5 five opposing locks win the game. Other clans' Reverse grade 3s count as Link Joker rear-guards at +4000 and lock when called.

ride.text: Cradle or a Reverse unit into Glendios; Worldline can search on the way up.

mulligan.text: Glendios and Cradle, with a Я card for Worldline's cost.

field.text: Я units on the rear-guard circles power Cradle's locks and Ruin Magician. Colony Maker was this build's choice over Cold Death Dragon.

resources.text: Praseodymium unflips per different Я rear-guard; Ruin Magician returns Я cards from the drop zone.

combat.text: Win through locks rather than through damage alone; the source notes other builds were readier to play around Omega Lock.

defence.text: Promethium as perfect guard; Rubidium redirects an attack to a Я rear-guard under Glendios.

recovery.text: Magnet Hollow searches a Я card on a hit.

matchups.text: Reported as stronger in central Japan than in Hokkaido, where Nouvelle Vague held the format.

winCondition.text: Legion with Blaster Blade Seeker, then at the end of the battle pay Counter-Blast 2, Soul-Blast 3 and two discards to search another Thing Saver, ride it standing and Legion again from the soul. Sources report it finishing first and second at the 2014 Tokyo regional.

ride.text: Sacred Wingal is the usual supporting grade 3; Thing Saver follows.

mulligan.text: Thing Saver and Sacred Wingal, then Gildas for the Legion call.

field.text: Gildas calls a Seeker on Legion; File calls Blaster Blade Seeker; Isbuzzard gains +4000 under a Legion.

resources.text: Soul fuels each repeat of the ability: three per ride, and earlier riding helps. Blaster Blade Seeker must be in the soul for the Legion to repeat.

combat.text: Vanguard attack, then stand; hold the discards for it.

defence.text: Iseult and Gloria as guards.

recovery.text: Without Legion, either grade 3 still has +2000 on attacking a vanguard.

winCondition.text: Blaster Blade Burst adds the original power of its front-row Royal Paladin rear-guards to its attack for Counter-Blast 2, on top of +3000.

ride.text: Blaster Blade at grade 2, Burst at grade 3.

mulligan.text: Burst and grade 1 and 2 rides.

field.text: High printed power in the front row counts most: Gallatin's 10000. Burst cannot be boosted, so the centre back circle is for spare units.

resources.text: Counter-Blast must use Royal Paladin cards; spend it on Burst first.

combat.text: Keep both front rear-guards in place until Burst has attacked.

defence.text: The product has no perfect guard, so it guards with shield only.

recovery.text: Bors and Marhaus still work if Burst is missed.
